scope: Isolated axial retention of pinned rigid SC geometry after force-driven seating. A one-axis slide constrains lateral translation and rotation; no robot, cable, recovery, physical latch model or hardware retention claim.
force_convention: Positive axis points from the port toward withdrawal. Actuator force equals declared net external axial force minus projected gravity force. Approach alone adds bounded velocity damping; all insertion holding force and damping are removed during the extraction-load phase.

acceptance.retention_definition: After verified force-driven seating, remains within the same1mm seating region throughout the2s load phase. The constrained fixture can demonstrate axial resistance only; zero-net-load persistence alone does not prove a mechanical latch.

stop_rule: If force-driven seating/dwell or contact positive control fails, report retention unassessable for that case. No geometry, attachment, force ceiling or success-threshold adjustment after seeing outcomes.
